clause_profiles.must: Determine relevant internal and external issues and record the climate-change relevance decision.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Context is current, material issues are evaluated, and the climate decision is explicit.

clause_profiles.must: Identify relevant interested parties, their relevant requirements, which requirements the ISMS addresses, and relevant climate-related expectations.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Parties and requirements are current, owned and traceable to Risks or obligations where appropriate.

clause_profiles.must: Define and maintain the ISMS scope after considering context, interested-party requirements, interfaces and dependencies.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: The documented scope has clear organizational, service, location, technology and dependency boundaries.

clause_profiles.must: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the ISMS and its interacting processes.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Processes, owners, inputs, outputs and interactions operate across the stated scope.

clause_profiles.must: Demonstrate top-management leadership, accountability, direction and support for the ISMS.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Leadership decisions, resources and business integration are evidenced rather than delegated in name only.

clause_profiles.must: Establish, approve, communicate and make available an information security policy appropriate to the organization.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: The current approved policy aligns to direction, objectives and continual improvement commitments.

clause_profiles.must: Assign and communicate relevant information security roles, responsibilities and authorities.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Named accountable roles cover ISMS conformity and performance reporting without material gaps.

clause_profiles.must: Plan actions for ISMS risks and opportunities, integrate them into ISMS processes and evaluate effectiveness.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Planning addresses intended outcomes, unwanted effects and improvement opportunities.

clause_profiles.must: Define and apply a consistent information security risk assessment process with criteria, identification, analysis, evaluation and ownership.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Criteria are repeatable and comparable, risk owners are identified, and results are retained.

clause_profiles.must: Define and apply risk treatment, determine necessary controls, compare them with Annex A, produce the SoA, plan treatment and obtain risk-owner approval.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Every treatment traces to necessary controls, Annex A omissions are considered, additional controls are captured, and residual risk is approved.

clause_profiles.must: Establish measurable information security objectives and plans covering owner, resources, actions, timing and evaluation.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Objectives are measurable where practicable, monitored, communicated, updated and linked to results.

clause_profiles.must: Carry out changes to the ISMS in a planned manner.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Material ISMS changes show purpose, consequences, resource needs and controlled implementation.

clause_profiles.must: Determine and provide resources needed for the ISMS.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Resource needs and unresolved gaps are visible to accountable management.

clause_profiles.must: Determine necessary competence, ensure competence and retain evidence for people whose work affects information security performance.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Role requirements and evidence of education, training or experience are current and effective.

clause_profiles.must: Ensure relevant people understand the policy, their contribution and consequences of nonconformity.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Awareness reaches the relevant population and is evidenced beyond mere content publication.

clause_profiles.must: Determine what, when, with whom and how to communicate about the ISMS.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Communication responsibilities, audiences and methods are defined and used.

clause_profiles.must: Maintain the documented information required by the standard and needed for an effective ISMS.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: The controlled document set is proportionate and distinguishes required, operational and recommended records.

clause_profiles.must: Control identification, format, review and approval when documented information is created or updated.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Documents have ownership, version, review and approval evidence.

clause_profiles.must: Control availability, protection, distribution, access, storage, preservation, retention, disposition and relevant external documents.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Information is available where needed and protected from loss, misuse and unauthorized change.

clause_profiles.must: Plan, implement and control ISMS processes, criteria, changes and relevant externally provided processes or services.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Operating criteria are used, planned changes are controlled and unintended changes are reviewed.

clause_profiles.must: Perform information security risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes are proposed or occur.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Assessments use approved criteria, cover change triggers and retain comparable results.

clause_profiles.must: Implement the approved information security risk treatment plan and retain results.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Treatments are performed, evidence is linked, and residual-risk decisions are current.

clause_profiles.must: Determine monitoring and measurement needs, methods, responsibilities and timing; analyse results and evaluate ISMS performance and effectiveness.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Metrics are decision-useful, repeatable and linked to retained results and follow-up.

clause_profiles.must: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals against organizational and ISO/IEC 27001 criteria.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Audit scope, criteria, evidence and conclusions demonstrate conformity and effective implementation.

clause_profiles.must: Plan, establish, implement and maintain an audit programme considering process importance and prior results; ensure objectivity and follow-up.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Coverage is risk-informed, responsibilities are assigned, independence is checked and results reach relevant management.

clause_profiles.must: Have top management review the ISMS at planned intervals for continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: The review is substantive, attended by accountable management and uses all required inputs.

clause_profiles.must: Provide management review inputs covering prior actions, changes, interested-party feedback, performance, objectives, audit results, risks and improvement opportunities.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: The review pack is complete, current and linked to authoritative records.
records: linked metrics, Risks, audits and prior Actions

clause_profiles.must: Record management review decisions on improvement opportunities and needed ISMS changes.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Decisions have accountable owners, due dates and traceable follow-up.

clause_profiles.must: Continually improve ISMS suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Improvement is evidenced by decisions and outcomes, not only open tasks.

clause_profiles.must: React to nonconformities, control and correct them, address consequences and causes, implement corrective action and review effectiveness.
clause_profiles.reviewer_verify: Finding, cause, Action, implementation and independent closure evidence form one traceable chain.

soa_model.purpose: One organization-specific register of necessary controls, including but not limited to Annex A.
rules: Every Annex A reference must appear exactly once for comparison, but need not be selected as necessary.
Every necessary control outside Annex A must also appear.
Necessary and Not Necessary both require rationale; implementation status applies only to necessary controls.
Not Necessary is the preferred ISO concept; the current runtime term Not Applicable requires an approved compatibility migration.
A SoA decision never changes Risk, Policy, Finding, Action or Evidence ownership.
Do not create an ISO-only duplicate Risk.
A treatment may select Annex A, external or custom controls.
Every SoA entry can trace back to the treatment decision that made the control necessary.
Implementation and Evidence do not silently close or re-rate the authoritative Risk.

control_implementation_model.rule: Assess the organization's implementation and evidence without inventing rigid technical tests for implementation-neutral controls.

internal_audit_program.cadence_rule: Planned intervals are required; ISO does not prescribe quarterly or annual frequency. Coverage is planned over the client-defined audit cycle.

required_input_topics: changes in internal and external issues
risk assessment results and risk treatment status
management_review.cadence_rule: Planned intervals are required; no numerical interval is asserted. Any annual default is Omnisciente recommended or client-selected.

objectives_model.rule: Prefer measurable, ongoing outcomes. One-time implementation tasks belong in Action Items, not the objectives register.

documented_information.record: risk assessment process and retained results
risk treatment process, SoA, treatment plan and risk-owner approval
information needed to show processes were carried out as planned
monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation results
audit programme implementation and audit results
nonconformity, actions taken and corrective-action results
additional documented information the organization determines necessary for ISMS effectiveness
process maps, responsibility matrix and registers used to make the explicit records usable

recurring_obligations.calendar: linked Review; do not delay treatment Actions

onboarding_flow: Enable ISO/IEC 27001 for the client without changing other framework state.
Confirm organizational context, interested parties and legal, regulatory and contractual requirement mappings.
Approve the ISMS scope and boundaries.
Initialize mandatory clause assessments and the 93-reference Annex A comparison set.
Establish the risk assessment method and perform the initial assessment in Risks.
Create the risk treatment plan and organization-specific SoA, including additional necessary controls.
Map existing Policies and identify justified policy gaps.
Select client cadences and create recurring Reviews and Calendar obligations.
Approve the internal audit programme and management review schedule.

auditor_navigation.question: Show me the Statement of Applicability.
Show me the internal audit programme and results.

Show me the risk that drove this control.

approval_decisions: Approve a backward-compatible persistence model for organization-specific SoA entries, including controls outside Annex A.
Approve terminology migration from included/excluded and Not Applicable to Necessary/Not Necessary while preserving stored history and APIs.
Approve whether objectives become a dedicated register or a typed view over existing authoritative records.
Approve replacing the current fixed four-package audit activation with a configurable programme cycle and coverage plan.
Provide licensed ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002:2022 access for exact title and normative completeness validation.
